turns.question: Which customer opened the most CRM emails between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many did they open?
turns.answer: No single customer opened the most: three customers (ids 1, 4 and 9) tie with 1 CRM email open each between 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-03 (customer_actions filtered to email_open). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
